content.json:
# 🪙 AI Gateway Tokenomics
Spend and plan enforcement for every **consumer** (APIM subscription) on every **plan** (APIM product), across **AI models**, **MCP tools** and **A2A agents**. Click a KPI to open its tab, and a 🔎 row to drill in.

parameters.name: Plan
parameters.label: Plan
parameters.query:
let budgets = datatable(Agent:string, AgentName:string, Tier:string, BudgetMicroUsd:long)[{budget-rows}];
budgets
| distinct Tier
| union (customMetrics | where name == "CostMicroUSD" | distinct Tier = tostring(customDimensions.Tier))
| where isnotempty(Tier)
| distinct Tier
| project value = Tier, label = strcat(toupper(substring(Tier, 0, 1)), substring(Tier, 1)), selected = false
| order by value asc

parameters.name: Consumer
parameters.label: Consumer
parameters.description: APIM subscription: an app, agent or user
parameters.query:
let budgets = datatable(Agent:string, AgentName:string, Tier:string, BudgetMicroUsd:long)[{budget-rows}];
budgets
| project Agent, AgentName, Tier
| union (customMetrics | where name == "CostMicroUSD"
    | distinct Agent = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Tier = tostring(customDimensions.Tier)
    | extend AgentName = Agent)
| where isnotempty(Agent) and ("*" in ({Plan}) or Tier in ({Plan}))
| summarize AgentName = take_any(AgentName), Tier = take_any(Tier) by Agent
| project value = Agent, label = AgentName, selected = false, group = strcat(toupper(substring(Tier, 0, 1)), substring(Tier, 1), " plan")
| order by group asc, label asc

content.query:
let cost = materialize(customMetrics
  | where name == "CostMicroUSD"
  | extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
           Resource = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Surface), "model"),
           Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Via), "direct"), Caller = tostring(customDimensions.Caller)
  | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
  | extend SurfaceName = case(Surface == "model", "AI models", Surface == "tool", "MCP tools", Surface == "agent", "A2A agents", Surface)
  );
let tokens = customMetrics
  | where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
  | extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
           Resource = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Surface), "model"),
           Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Via), "direct"), Caller = tostring(customDimensions.Caller)
  | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
  | extend SurfaceName = case(Surface == "model", "AI models", Surface == "tool", "MCP tools", Surface == "agent", "A2A agents", Surface)
  ;
let gov = customMetrics
  | where name == "GovernanceEvents"
  | extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
           Event = tostring(customDimensions.Event), RequestedModel = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = "model"
  | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer}))
  ;
let failover = customMetrics | where name == "BackendAttempts" and tostring(customDimensions.Failover) == "yes"
  | extend Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier), Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Surface = "model"
  | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer}));
let gateway = workspace("{law-id}").ApiManagementGatewayLogs
  | where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "commerce-api", "sourcing-agent")
  | extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,
           Surface = case(ApiId == "inference-api", "model", ApiId == "sourcing-agent", "agent", "tool")
  | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}));
let tiles = datatable(Order:int, Metric:string, Tab:string)[
  1, "Spend ($)", "overview", 2, "Cost per 1K calls ($)", "chargeback", 3, "Tokens", "overview",
  4, "Gateway calls", "evidence", 5, "Blocked by policy (%)", "governance", 6, "Plan enforcements", "governance",
  7, "Regional failovers", "evidence"];
union
  (cost | make-series s = sum(valueSum), c = sum(valueCount) default = 0 on timestamp step {TimeRange:grain}
   | extend S = array_sum(s), C = array_sum(c)
   | project Row = pack_array(
       bag_pack("Order", 1, "Value", S / 1e6, "Detail", strcat(tolong(C), " priced calls"), "Trend", series_multiply(s, 1e-6)),
       bag_pack("Order", 2, "Value", iff(C > 0, 1000 * S / 1e6 / C, 0.0), "Detail", "average, all surfaces",
                "Trend", series_multiply(series_divide(s, series_add(c, 1e-9)), 1e-3)))
   | mv-expand Row),
  (tokens | make-series v = sum(valueSum) default = 0 on timestamp step {TimeRange:grain} | project Row = bag_pack("Order", 3, "Value", array_sum(v), "Detail", "prompt + completion", "Trend", v)),
  (gateway | make-series n = count(), b = countif(ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429)) default = 0 on TimeGenerated step {TimeRange:grain}
   | extend N = array_sum(n), B = array_sum(b)
   | project Row = pack_array(
       bag_pack("Order", 4, "Value", N, "Detail", "models, tools and agents", "Trend", n),
       bag_pack("Order", 5, "Value", round(100.0 * B / iff(N == 0, 1.0, N), 1), "Detail", strcat(tolong(B), " calls got 401, 403 or 429"),
                "Trend", b))
   | mv-expand Row),
  (gov | make-series v = sum(valueSum) default = 0 on timestamp step {TimeRange:grain} | project Row = bag_pack("Order", 6, "Value", array_sum(v), "Detail", "downgrades, denials, caps", "Trend", v)),
  (failover | make-series v = sum(valueCount) default = 0 on timestamp step {TimeRange:grain} | project Row = bag_pack("Order", 7, "Value", array_sum(v), "Detail", "retried in another region", "Trend", v))
| project Order = toint(Row.Order), Value = todouble(Row.Value), Detail = tostring(Row.Detail), Trend = Row.Trend
| join kind=rightouter tiles on Order
| project Order = Order1, Metric, Value = coalesce(Value, 0.0), Detail = coalesce(Detail, "none in this time range"), Trend, Tab
| order by Order asc

customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
         Resource = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Surface), "model"),
         Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Via), "direct"), Caller = tostring(customDimensions.Caller)
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend SurfaceName = case(Surface == "model", "AI models", Surface == "tool", "MCP tools", Surface == "agent", "A2A agents", Surface)
| summarize CostUSD = sum(valueSum) / 1e6 by SurfaceName, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Spend over time by surface

content.query:
let budgets = datatable(Agent:string, AgentName:string, Tier:string, BudgetMicroUsd:long)[{budget-rows}];
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
         Resource = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Surface), "model"),
         Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Via), "direct"), Caller = tostring(customDimensions.Caller)

content.json: Every priced call writes a **chargeback record** with the payer's team, cost center, user and session. Spend an A2A agent makes for a user is charged to that user and session (**Via**).

content.query:
traces
| where tostring(customDimensions.record) == "chargeback"
| extend Team = tostring(customDimensions.team), CostCenter = tostring(customDimensions.costCenter),
         Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.user), Name = tostring(customDimensions.displayName),
         Kind = tostring(customDimensions["kind"]), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.tier),
         Session = tostring(customDimensions.session), Surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface),
         Item = tostring(customDimensions.item), Via = tostring(customDimensions.via),
         Caller = tostring(customDimensions.caller), RequestId = tostring(customDimensions.requestId),
         CostUSD = tolong(customDimensions.costMicroUsd) / 1e6,
         Tokens = tolong(customDimensions.promptTokens) + tolong(customDimensions.completionTokens)
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend SurfaceName = case(Surface == "model", "AI models", Surface == "tool", "MCP tools", Surface == "agent", "A2A agents", Surface)
| summarize SpendUSD = sum(CostUSD) by Team = strcat(Team, " · ", CostCenter)
content.title: Spend by team

content.query:
traces
| where tostring(customDimensions.record) == "chargeback"
| extend Team = tostring(customDimensions.team), CostCenter = tostring(customDimensions.costCenter),
         Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.user), Name = tostring(customDimensions.displayName),
         Kind = tostring(customDimensions["kind"]), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.tier),

traces

         Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.user), Name = tostring(customDimensions.displayName),

content.title: Call-by-call ledger

content.query:
let budgets = datatable(Agent:string, AgentName:string, Tier:string, BudgetMicroUsd:long)[{budget-rows}];
customMetrics
| where name == "CostMicroUSD"
| extend Consumer = tostring(customDimensions.Agent), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier),
         Resource = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Surface = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Surface), "model"),
         Via = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.Via), "direct"), Caller = tostring(customDimensions.Caller)
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend SurfaceName = case(Surface == "model", "AI models", Surface == "tool", "MCP tools", Surface == "agent", "A2A agents", Surface)
| summarize Spent = sum(valueSum) by Consumer
| join kind=rightouter (budgets | where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Tier in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Agent in ({Consumer}))) on $left.Consumer == $right.Agent
| project Name = AgentName, Plan = Tier, BudgetUSD = BudgetMicroUsd / 1e6, SpentUSD = coalesce(Spent, 0.0) / 1e6
| extend RemainingUSD = max_of(BudgetUSD - SpentUSD, 0.0), UsedPercent = round(100.0 * SpentUSD / BudgetUSD, 1)
| order by UsedPercent desc
content.title: Budget burn: spend in the time range vs the plan budget

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "commerce-api", "sourcing-agent")
| extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,
         Surface = case(ApiId == "inference-api", "model", ApiId == "sourcing-agent", "agent", "tool")
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend Outcome = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "Allowed", ResponseCode == 401, "Unauthenticated (401)",
                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| summarize Calls = count() by Plan = iff(isempty(Plan), "(no plan)", Plan), Outcome
content.title: Call outcomes by plan

content.query:

| extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,

| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))

                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| where ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429)
| summarize Calls = count() by Outcome, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})

content.json: From the **Log Analytics** gateway tables. *Stopped by* is the policy that ended the call (`LastErrorSource`); `CorrelationId` matches the `x-gw-request-id` response header.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "commerce-api", "sourcing-agent")
| extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,
         Surface = case(ApiId == "inference-api", "model", ApiId == "sourcing-agent", "agent", "tool")
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend Outcome = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "Allowed", ResponseCode == 401, "Unauthenticated (401)",
                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| summarize Calls = count(), Plans = make_set_if(Plan, isnotempty(Plan)), Consumers = dcount(Consumer) by Policy, Outcome, Reason = LastErrorReason
| extend Plans = strcat_array(Plans, ", ")
| order by Calls desc
content.title: 🔎 What each policy did: click a row to see the calls it stopped

                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| summarize Calls = count(), p50 = percentile(TotalTime, 50), p95 = percentile(TotalTime, 95),
            BackendP95 = percentile(BackendTime, 95) by ApiId
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Latency by surface (ms)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "commerce-api", "sourcing-agent")
| extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,
         Surface = case(ApiId == "inference-api", "model", ApiId == "sourcing-agent", "agent", "tool")
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend Outcome = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "Allowed", ResponseCode == 401, "Unauthenticated (401)",
                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| where Policy == '{SelectedPolicy}'
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, ApiId, Plan, Consumer, ResponseCode, LastErrorReason, LastErrorMessage
| take 200
content.title: 🚦 Calls stopped by {SelectedPolicy}

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ApiId in ("inference-api", "commerce-mcp", "commerce-api", "sourcing-agent")
| extend Plan = ProductId, Consumer = ApimSubscriptionId,
         Surface = case(ApiId == "inference-api", "model", ApiId == "sourcing-agent", "agent", "tool")
| where ("*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})) and ("*" in ({Consumer}) or Consumer in ({Consumer})) and ("*" in ({Surface}) or Surface in ({Surface}))
| extend Outcome = case(ResponseCode between (200 .. 299), "Allowed", ResponseCode == 401, "Unauthenticated (401)",
                        ResponseCode == 403, "Denied: plan, quota or budget (403)", ResponseCode == 429, "Throttled (429)",
                        ResponseCode >= 500 or ResponseCode == 0, "Backend error (5xx)", "Other (4xx)"),
         Policy = iff(isempty(LastErrorSource), "(none: call passed)", LastErrorSource)
| where ApiId == "inference-api" and isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend Backend = tostring(split(parse_url(BackendUrl).Host, ".")[0])
| summarize Calls = count() by Backend, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Load balancing: Foundry backend that served each model call

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "BackendAttempts"
| extend Backend = tostring(customDimensions.Backend), Failover = tostring(customDimensions.Failover),
         Model = tostring(customDimensions.Model), Plan = tostring(customDimensions.Tier)
| where "*" in ({Plan}) or Plan in ({Plan})
| summarize Requests = sum(valueCount), Attempts = sum(valueSum) by Backend, Failover = iff(Failover == "yes", "🔁 yes", "no")
| extend AttemptsPerRequest = round(1.0 * Attempts / Requests, 2)
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Failover: attempts per request

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where isnotempty(DeploymentName)
| summarize Calls = dcount(CorrelationId), PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens), CompletionTokens = sum(CompletionTokens) by DeploymentName
| extend TotalTokens = PromptTokens + CompletionTokens
| order by TotalTokens desc
content.title: Tokens counted by the gateway per deployment

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog
| where isnotempty(ToolName)
| summarize Calls = count(), Errors = countif(isnotempty(Error)) by ToolName, ClientName, AuthenticationMethod
| order by Calls desc
content.title: MCP tool calls

content.json:
**Where the numbers come from**

| Data | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Spend, tokens | `customMetrics` (`CostMicroUSD`, token metrics) | Priced at the gateway from the `model-pricing`, `tool-pricing` and `agent-pricing` named values |
| Plan enforcement | `customMetrics` (`GovernanceEvents`) | Model downgrade or deny, output caps, tool or agent denied |
| Failover | `customMetrics` (`BackendAttempts`) | Attempts per request and the region that answered |
| Chargeback | `traces` (`record == "chargeback"`) | One record per priced call with team, cost center, user and session. Custom metrics allow at most 5 dimensions, so per-user and per-session data lives here |
| Policy evidence | Log Analytics: `ApiManagementGatewayLogs`, `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog`, `ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog` | `CorrelationId` equals the `x-gw-request-id` response header |

**Via** is the A2A agent that spent on the consumer's behalf: an agent's model and tool calls are charged back to the consumer that sent it the task, so a session total is the fully loaded cost. Metrics arrive 1 to 3 minutes after a call, diagnostic logs 2 to 5 minutes.
